## Problem and expected behavior

Describe what you expected and what happened.

## Reproduction

Include the exact command, a small synthetic targets configuration, output and
error message. Remove secrets and private endpoints. For undisclosed
vulnerabilities use SECURITY.md.

## Environment

Addon commit, Empeira version, Ruby version, rsync version and host OS.

## Before submitting

- [ ] I searched existing issues.
- [ ] The example contains no production data or secrets.
